statements.source_text: The lights prescribed in these Rules shall have an intensity as specified in Section 8 Annex I
statements.predicate: A vessel's prescribed lights must have the intensity specified in Section 8 of Annex I.

statements.source_text: In vessels of 50 metres or more in length
statements.predicate: The listed minimum visibility ranges apply to vessels at least 50 metres in length.
A prescribed masthead light must be visible at a minimum range of 6 miles.
A prescribed sidelight must be visible at a minimum range of 3 miles.
A prescribed sternlight must be visible at a minimum range of 3 miles.
A prescribed towing light must be visible at a minimum range of 3 miles.

statements.source_text: a white, red, green or yellow all-round light, 3 miles
statements.predicate: A prescribed white, red, green or yellow all-round light must be visible at a minimum range of 3 miles.
